No text, lettering, logo, watermark, symbols, sacred patterns, pan-Indigenous headdresses, golden jewelry, invented ritual, extra people or props. This is a new composition, not a crop of the reference.

Do not add any reference person, animal, lake or staff just because it appears in a reference.
